card.name: Numbers in scholarly citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits inside academic reference citations, such as C.P. volume-page numbers, hyphens between them, and paragraph or chapter numbers. It also fires on small separators in footnote lists.

modes.label: Peirce C.P. references
modes.description: Hyphen or digit inside a Collected Papers citation like C.P. 7-356.

modes.label: Classical footnote citations
modes.description: Comma or number inside short references to ancient works in footnotes.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers and punctuation inside scholarly citations and footnote references.
